name_en: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
benefit: Street vendors get a small working capital loan with no security and no processing fee. If you repay on time, you get a 7% interest subsidy and can get bigger loans later. The loan limits were raised recently, so ask your bank for the current amount.

other: You must be a street vendor.
You need a Certificate of Vending or ID card from the urban local body, or a Letter of Recommendation from the ULB or Town Vending Committee.

documents: Certificate of Vending or ID card (or Letter of Recommendation)
Aadhaar, voter ID, driving licence, MNREGA card or PAN card
For the second loan: proof the first loan is closed
how_to_apply: Go to pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in and log in with your mobile number and OTP. Pick your vendor category and enter your Survey Reference Number. Fill the form, upload papers and submit.
helpline: Toll free 1800111979 (9.30 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Saturday)

evidence.quote: No collateral is required to avail of the loan
